text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right before the Kashiwa Kinen. You try to 
fire up Wonder Acute with an encouraging 
shoulder pat... but her spirit remains 
unignited.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she resolved to run with all her 
might. It seemed as though she was trying 
to ascertain something through this race.
